influences.name: Nina Simone
influences.context: My mum then introduced me to loads of female singers. We used to play a game called 'Who's singing?', where she'd play me voices and I'd have to guess 'Nina Simone' or 'Ella Fitzgerald' or 'Mahalia Jackson'. That's how I got into those real soulful, strong female voices.
